# Oyetunji Taofeek Ololade

> Backend Software Engineer & Technical Educator specializing in Golang, Python, PostgreSQL, and real-time collaborative systems. Founder of Logixia Academy.

## Summary
Oyetunji Taofeek Ololade is a backend engineer based in Ilorin, Kwara State, Nigeria. He specializes in designing scalable server architecture, building high-performance REST APIs, WebSocket integrations, and interactive developer tools. He leads projects end-to-end—from system design and PostgreSQL schema optimization to web UX.

## Core Technical Stack
- **Languages:** Golang, Python, JavaScript (ES6+), SQL
- **Backend & Architecture:** RESTful APIs, WebSockets, API Design, System Architecture, Microservices
- **Databases & Storage:** PostgreSQL (Schema Design, Query Optimization), Supabase
- **Frontend & Runtimes:** React, CodeMirror 6, Pyodide (Wasm Python Runtime)
- **Tools & Infrastructure:** Linux/Ubuntu, Git, Render, Paystack API Integration

## Featured Projects & Work Experience

### Logixia Academy
- **URL:** https://logixia.com.ng
- **Role:** Founder & Lead Instructor (March 2026 – Present)
- **Details:** Built an interactive live-coding education platform solo. Features a real-time collaborative code workspace (CodeMirror 6, single-writer model), client-side Python execution (Pyodide) for auto-graded challenges, and automated Paystack cohort billing via Supabase Edge Functions.

### Gopher OS
- **URL:** https://go-learning-lab.vercel.app
- **Role:** Creator & Lead Developer
- **Details:** Interactive Go programming learning lab built for participants in the Learn2Earn program. Scaled to over 600 peak active users.

### Mstar Innovation Limited
- **Role:** Manager & Technical Lead (Jan 2025 – Sep 2025)
- **Details:** Directed the technical architectural upgrade and query performance refactoring of `osunyouthaffairs.com`, the official Osun State Youth Affairs digital portal.
